name: fleet-dm
command: [ -n "$FLEET_NAME" ] && exec fleet "$FLEET_NAME" tail dm || echo "fleet plugin: FLEET_NAME is not set, no private-message feed (start claude with FLEET_NAME=<identity>)"
description: Fleet chat: private messages to $FLEET_NAME (one JSON line per message; act on each)

name: fleet-chan
command: [ -n "$FLEET_NAME" ] && exec fleet "$FLEET_NAME" tail chan || echo "fleet plugin: FLEET_NAME is not set, no room feed (start claude with FLEET_NAME=<identity>)"
description: Fleet chat: every room (one JSON line per message; act only when to names $FLEET_NAME)
